title: EvidenceArtefactRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the EvidenceArtefactRecorded platform event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8, §28.18; class: platform; FR-AH.15, INV-REQ-1226 b1-b2, INV-ADR-285). Owned by service-runtime alone (STK-61), as drafted in INV-API-3310 (INV-Q-3257). Authored by INV-T-3313. evidence-svc records each artefact once: unique on (artefactType, reference, hash). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

artefactType.description: The kind of evidence artefact recorded, e.g. a rendition, register lookup, rate record, sample check or import (INV-NOTE-3 SB-06).

reference.description: The producer's reference to the recorded artefact.

hash.description: The hash of the recorded artefact's content.
